name: @relayhub/node-experimental
description: Experimental backend-only RelayHub Rust v1 SDK; not for cutover or browsers

scripts.build: tsc --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --declaration --outDir dist src/client.ts src/agent.ts
